scope: Completed the existing uncommitted DemoCardPayment/CheckoutPage/purchasing CSS and test edits; preserved unrelated wishlist, artwork and deployment work.

implementation.ui: Temporary component card/billing state, exact three-number allowlist, future-month MM/YY expiry, three-digit masked CVC, required holder/country/postal fields, masked preview, sample buttons, reviewed server summary, one total-priced Pay action, progress and processing state.
implementation.verification: Local modal with public code 123456, wrong-code feedback, trapped Tab/Shift+Tab focus, Cancel/Escape and focus restoration. No provider connection.
implementation.api: Unchanged POST /api/v1/checkout contract: quote_token, idempotency_key, scenario approve/decline only.
implementation.retry: Synchronous duplicate-event guard; account-scoped metadata survives unknown outcome, 429/419 and session expiry; definitive quote conflicts require fresh confirmation.
implementation.card_storage: None. Card/billing/code values exist only in component memory and clear on accepted submission/cancellation/unmount/reload. Pending sessionStorage contains only the three existing protocol fields.

coverage: Required and invalid fields, unsupported/overlong card numbers, formatting, current/past/invalid month and short CVC rejection
Exact server-priced Pay label, preview/masking, immediate field clearing during held request
Two synchronous submit events yield one network request/order; metadata-only network/storage and no card values in logs/URLs
Verification wrong code then success; zero purchase requests before confirmation
Cancellation by Escape and button at 320px; no order, retained cart, focus restoration and another successful attempt
Lost approved result recovered after logout/session-expiry and reauthentication with identical idempotency payload
Existing approval/key history, decline/cart retention/retry, owner isolation, CSRF/session revocation, stale quote conflicts
Interrupted response, reload, transient 429 and another reload recover one order using identical payloads

backend.note: Backend business logic is unchanged by the card form. Full suite also covers the preceding artwork backfill.

preservation.business_logic: Owner scoping, quote/version checks, stock/price checks, transactional allocation, idempotency and order history retained.

full_browser_regression.delivery: Compiled production React and Laravel native HTTP, development PostgreSQL; process-only QA cache/hash settings.
full_browser_regression.note: All current browser cases ran after final application changes. Full sweep includes card input clearing across reload at 320px.

limits: Chromium automation and visual desktop/mobile review; no physical-device, Safari, Firefox or screen-reader session.
Billing validation is demonstration-only; no address verification, payment provider or bank authentication.
If sessionStorage is blocked, the existing fallback retains retry metadata only in current-page memory; order history remains available.
Only development fixtures were purchased. No public deployment performed.

normal_preview_smoke.runtime: Vite plus Laravel restarted without the QA cache/hash overrides; existing database/session configuration retained.
cases: Authenticated sample-card form, keyboard and axe at 390px
